newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-INDIANS' MESA INDICTED ON RAPE CHARGE.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-INDIANS' MESA INDICTED ON RAPE CHARGE.

text.p: Cleveland Indians closer Jose Mesa was indicted on a rape and five other charges by a Cuyahoga County grand jury on Thursday.

Mesa, who along with a friend pleaded innocent to charges stemming from a December 22nd incident in Lakewood, Ohio, was also indicted for one count of felonious assault, two counts of gross sexual imposition, one count of theft and one count of carrying a concealed weapon by the grand jury.
Mesa's friend, 34-year-old David Blanco, was indicted on one count of gross sexual imposition and one count of carrying a concealed weapon. The two will be arraigned on January 31st.
